text:
A one-page website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Visitors see the menu with prices, the opening hours and where to find the shop, and they can pre-order a coffee for pickup. Users: coffee lovers and office staff nearby. Problem: people cannot see the menu or order ahead. Must-have: menu with prices, pre-order form, map or address, opening hours. Constraints: one page only, works on phones, no payment. Success: 30 pre-orders per week.
Items and prices (rupees): Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120.
Open: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm, Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm.
Address: 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.
Contact: show phone +91 98450 12345 and email hello@brewlab.example.
Pre-orders: the customer enters name, phone, items and pickup time, and the order is emailed to hello@brewlab.example. No online payment, they pay at pickup.
Write the design docs first.
Documents asked for: the PRD, the HLD and the LLD, then the website. They are written in that order, each from the one before.
@Requester I have everything I need from your brief, so I have no questions. The team will now write the product plan first, then the technical plans, then the website.

@Adaptation Propose the workflows to write the PRD for Brew Lab. It must hold every fact in the goal exactly as given and cover Problem, Users, Goals, Requirements, Success metrics and Out of scope. The HLD, LLD and website follow later, each from the document before.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 10 checkable done-when items. Work can start.
@Priority Six workflows, one per PRD section in order, each building on the one before. Requirements is four items (4-7). Out of scope also covers item 10 (no to-be-confirmed items).
